description: Returns the depreciation of an asset for a specified period using the fixed-declining balance method.

params.description: The initial cost of the asset.
params.name: arg1

params.description: The salvage value of the asset at the end of its lifetime.
params.name: arg2

params.description: The number of periods over which the asset is being depreciated (sometimes called the useful life of the asset).
params.name: arg3

params.description: The period for which the depreciation will be calculated. Period must use the same units as the useful life of the asset.
params.name: arg4

params.description: The number of months in the first year. If this parameter is omitted, it is assumed to be 12.
params.name: arg5

signature: DB(arg1: ApiRange | ApiName | number, arg2: ApiRange | ApiName | number, arg3: ApiRange | ApiName | number, arg4: ApiRange | ApiName | number, arg5?: ApiRange | ApiName | number): number
